body:
I purchased an ounce of sun opener, smoked about 3 joints worth, didn't feel anything so I put the rest in an empty alcohol bottle. I filled with water and left inside my car for three days during the summer. I drank the whole thing in about an hour and I didn't feel anything all day. The next day every muscle in my body felt like I overworked them all night long. I was too sore to get up and perform any mundane task for the whole day. Not recommended at such a high dose for first timers.
